pins.name: GPIO0
pins.label: GPIO0
pins.notes:
TFT_RESET - dedicated TFT display reset line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.label: GPIO1
pins.notes:
DENSITY_PIN (34-pin IDC 2) / APPLE2_ENABLE_PIN (Apple II DRVEN/, IDC 14) - dedicated floppy interface signal, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2
pins.notes:
SELECT_PIN (34-pin IDC 12) - dedicated floppy drive-select line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO3
pins.label: GPIO3
pins.notes:
MOTOR_PIN (34-pin IDC 16) / APPLE2_PHASE4_PIN (Apple II Phi3) - dedicated floppy motor-enable / Apple II stepper-phase line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO4
pins.label: GPIO4
pins.notes:
DIR_PIN (34-pin IDC 18) / APPLE2_PHASE3_PIN (Apple II Phi2) - dedicated floppy step-direction / Apple II stepper-phase line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO5
pins.label: GPIO5
pins.notes:
STEP_PIN (34-pin IDC 20) / APPLE2_PHASE2_PIN (Apple II Phi1) - dedicated floppy step-pulse / Apple II stepper-phase line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO6
pins.label: GPIO6
pins.notes:
WRDATA_PIN (34-pin IDC 22) / APPLE2_WRDATA_PIN - dedicated floppy write-data line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO7
pins.label: GPIO7
pins.notes:
WRGATE_PIN (34-pin IDC 24) / APPLE2_WRGATE_PIN (WR REQ) - dedicated floppy write-gate line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO8
pins.label: GPIO8
pins.notes:
SIDE_PIN (34-pin IDC 32) / APPLE2_PHASE1_PIN (Apple II Phi0) - dedicated floppy side-select / Apple II stepper-phase line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO9
pins.label: GPIO9
pins.notes:
FLOPPY_DIRECTION_PIN - dedicated: sets onboard level-shifter direction for floppy emulation mode (drive-facing vs host-facing), driven as an output at setup() in Adafruit's reference firmware. Not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO10
pins.label: GPIO10
pins.notes:
INDEX_PIN (34-pin IDC 8) - dedicated floppy index-pulse input, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO11
pins.label: GPIO11
pins.notes:
TRK0_PIN (34-pin IDC 26) - dedicated floppy track-0-sense input, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO12
pins.label: GPIO12
pins.notes:
PROT_PIN (34-pin IDC 28) / APPLE2_PROTECT_PIN (W PROT) - dedicated floppy write-protect-sense input, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO13
pins.label: GPIO13
pins.notes:
READ_PIN (34-pin IDC 30) / APPLE2_RDDATA_PIN (RD DATA) - dedicated floppy read-data input, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO14
pins.label: GPIO14
pins.notes:
READY_PIN (34-pin IDC 34) - dedicated floppy ready/disk-change input, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO15
pins.label: GPIO15
pins.notes:
FLOPPY_ENABLE_PIN - dedicated: enables onboard level-shifters/floppy interface driver hardware (active low), driven as an output at setup() in Adafruit's reference firmware. Not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO21
pins.label: GPIO21
pins.notes:
PIN_CARD_CS - dedicated SD-card chip-select line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D22
pins.label: GPIO22 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL - onboard WS2812-style addressable status LED data line.

pins.name: GPIO23
pins.label: GPIO23
pins.notes:
TFT_DC - dedicated TFT data/command select line, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO24)
pins.notes: TFT_CS (also aliased PIN_SPI0_SS) - dedicated TFT chip-select. spi_ss capability is auto-supplied by build_boards.js from this board's SPI0 SS alias; no general digital/pwm role offered.

pins.name: GPIO25
pins.label: GPIO25
pins.notes:
TFT_BACKLIGHT - dedicated TFT backlight control line, driven directly by reference firmware. Not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO26
pins.label: GPIO26
pins.notes:
APPLE2_INDEX_PIN - dedicated Apple II disk-interface index/sense input from the separate SENSE 1 JST connector, not general purpose.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D28/A2
pins.label: GPIO28 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED (also aliased A2) - onboard user status LED, confirmed active-high per Adafruit's consistent RP2040-line LED convention (see pfodWeb NOTE above).
